stem: Which of the following equations represents the third equation of motion, relating initial velocity ($v_i$), final velocity ($v_f$), acceleration ($a$), and distance ($S$)?
solution_latex: The context states that the third equation of motion represents the relation between initial velocity, final velocity, acceleration, and distance. Equation (3.4) is given as $2aS = (v_i + v_f) \\times (v_f - v_i)$. This equation can also be written as $2aS = v_f^2 - v_i^2$, which is equivalent to $v_f^2 = v_i^2 + 2aS$. Therefore, option A correctly represents the third equation of motion as derived in the text.
